solution.title: Anomaly Detection & Application Reliability with Endpoint Analytics

products.name: Anomaly Detection & Application Reliability with Endpoint Analytics — Commercial
products.short_description: Find the app crashes, device restarts, and fleet-wide anomalies that erode reliability — before they become a wave of tickets — using Endpoint Analytics reliability and anomaly signals.
products.description:
Find the app crashes, device restarts, and fleet-wide anomalies that erode reliability — before they become a wave of tickets — using Endpoint Analytics reliability and anomaly signals.

Reliability problems hide in aggregate: one app crashing on a few hundred devices, an OS update quietly raising restart rates, a driver regressing a hardware model. Endpoint Analytics surfaces these through application reliability, device reliability/restart analytics, and anomaly detection — but the signals only help if someone knows how to read them and act. This solution operationalizes the reliability side of Endpoint Analytics: interpreting application- and device-reliability scores, using anomaly detection to catch a regression across the fleet early, triaging to the responsible app/driver/update, and closing the loop — with Proactive Remediations pointed to for the automated fix and the flagship Endpoint Analytics product as the parent.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Application reliability — read crash/hang signals by app and version, separate a bad app from a bad rollout, and prioritize by user impact
  • Device reliability & restart analytics — restart causes, unexpected-restart trends, and mapping a spike to an update or driver
  • Anomaly detection — catch a fleet-wide regression early, read what the anomaly is telling you, and rule out false signals
  • Triage + close the loop — route to the responsible app/driver/update owner, and hand the fix to Proactive Remediations (pointer) where scriptable
  • Reliability review cadence — a repeatable practice that turns these signals into prevented tickets

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A reliability practice built on Endpoint Analytics that catches app crashes, restart spikes, and fleet-wide anomalies early — and routes each to the right fix before it becomes a ticket wave.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENDPTREL-Discovery.ps1 — read-only discovery of Endpoint Analytics reliability data
    • ENDPTREL-Report.ps1 — export an application + device reliability + anomaly summary to CSV
    • ENDPTREL-Set-ReviewScope.ps1 — create/assign the 'Reliability – Review Scope' group for the cadence
    • ENDPTREL-Test-Signal.ps1 — confirm a known reliability signal is visible and attributable
    • ENDPTREL-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL readiness gate for the reliability practice on a pilot scope

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
